d: Eeran ne dava kiya hai ki usne bahrin men ameriki arli-vorning radar ko nasht kar diya hai. halanki, ameriki sentkom ne is dave ko kharij kiya hai. bahrin amerika ke lie rannitik rup se behad aham hai. yahan ameriki nausena ki fifth flit ka mukhyalay hai, jo khari, oman ki khari, lal sagar aur hind mahasagar ke bare samudri ilaqe men ameriki abhiyanon ki nigrani karti hai.
